May it be your will to lengthen our life in goodness, and let me be counted among the righteous, so that you have mercy on me and guard me and all that is mine and your people Israel's. You feed and sustain all; you rule over all; you rule over kings, and the kingdom is yours. I am a servant of the Holy One, blessed be he, before whom and before whose glorious Torah I bow at every time. Not in any person do I trust, and not on any angel do I rely, but on the God of heaven, who is the God of truth, whose Torah is truth and whose prophets are truth, and who abounds in deeds of goodness and truth. In him I trust, and to his holy and glorious name I utter praises. May it be your will to open my heart to Torah, to fulfil the requests of my heart and the heart of all your people Israel, for good, for life and for peace.

This is Ayin — AH-yeen. Sound: silent in modern Israeli Hebrew, like Aleph. Shape hook: a lowercase y that sits on the floor: two arms from one low join, tail bent flat, right arm taller. Tip: Both arms grow from ONE spot down near the floor and nothing continues above or below that join (the tail just bends flat along the baseline); not Tsadi, Aleph.
האות עַיִן. שקטה בעברית ישראלית מודרנית, כמו אלף. תסתכלו על הצורה: a lowercase y that sits on the floor: two arms from one low join, tail bent flat, right arm taller. שימו לב לא לבלבל עם צ · א.

This is Bet — BET. Sound: B as in ball when it has a dot; V as in van without the dot. Shape hook: open-left box with an extra-long floor. Tip: Flat top plus flat bottom distinguishes rounded Kaf; no inner bar unlike Pe; do not mix it up with Kaf, Pe.

This is Chet — KHET. Sound: a throaty KH, like the ch in Bach. Shape hook: bridge with both legs attached. Tip: Both verticals touch the horizontal roof; He has a separated left post; do not mix it up with He, Tav.
האות חֵית. נשמעת כמו ח גרונית. תסתכלו על הצורה: bridge with both legs attached. שימו לב לא לבלבל עם ה · ת.
This is Dalet — DAH-let. Sound: D as in door. Shape hook: square table corner. Tip: The sharp corner and projecting roof separate Dalet from Resh’s rounded shoulder; do not mix it up with Resh.
האות דָּלֶת. נשמעת כמו דּ בדלת. תסתכלו על הצורה: square table corner. שימו לב לא לבלבל עם ר.
This is Gimel — GHEE-mel. Sound: hard G as in go. Shape hook: walking stick taking a step. Tip: A downward slanting leg gives Gimel its step, missing from Nun or Vav; do not mix it up with Nun, Vav.
האות גִּימֶל. נשמעת כמו גּ בגו. תסתכלו על הצורה: walking stick taking a step. שימו לב לא לבלבל עם נ · ו.
This is He — HEY. Sound: H as in hat. Shape hook: doorway with detached left post. Tip: Left post is visibly detached below the roof; Chet and Tav attach differently; do not mix it up with Chet, Tav.
האות הֵא. נשמעת כמו ה בהר. תסתכלו על הצורה: doorway with detached left post. שימו לב לא לבלבל עם ח · ת.

This is Kaf — KAHF. Sound: K as in kite with a dot; throaty KH without the dot. Shape hook: rounded open-left mitten. Tip: Its upper-left turn is smooth, unlike Bet’s boxy square roof and floor; do not mix it up with Bet, Pe.

english:
HEAR, O ISRAEL: THE LORD OUR GOD, THE LORD IS ONE.
And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be upon thy heart;
and thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thy hand, and they shall be for frontlets between thine eyes.
And thou shalt write them upon the door-posts of thy house, and upon thy gates.

english:
A Song of Ascents. When the LORD brought back those that returned to Zion, We were like unto them that dream.
Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing; then said they among the nations: 'The LORD hath done great things with these.'
The LORD hath done great things with us; we are rejoiced.
Turn our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the dry land.
They that sow in tears Shall reap in joy.
Though he goeth on his way weeping that beareth the measure of seed, He shall come home with joy, bearing his sheaves.

Blessed are you, LORD, who blesses his people Israel with peace.

May it be your will to lengthen our life in goodness, and let me be counted among the righteous, so that you have mercy on me and guard me and all that is mine and your people Israel's. english: Blessed is the name of the Master of the world; blessed is your crown and your place. May your good will be with your people Israel for ever; show your people the redemption of your right hand in your Temple, bring us of the goodness of your light, and accept our prayer in mercy. May it be your will to lengthen our life in goodness, and let me be counted among the righteous, so that you have mercy on me and guard me and all that is mine and your people Israel's. You feed and sustain all; you rule over all; you rule over kings, and the kingdom is yours. I am a servant of the Holy One, blessed be he, before whom and before whose glorious Torah I bow at every time. Not in any person do I trust, and not on any angel do I rely, but on the God of heaven, who is the God of truth, whose Torah is truth and whose prophets are truth, and who abounds in deeds of goodness and truth. In him I trust, and to his holy and glorious name I utter praises. May it be your will to open my heart to Torah, to fulfil the requests of my heart and the heart of all your people Israel, for good, for life and for peace.
